title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 11, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: unslothai/unsloth is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: unslothai/unsloth leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: unslothai/unsloth — 3 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 68.3 below its current daily pace, with 4 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 92 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
andrewyng/openworker — No same-day commit after 80 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Watch for a released diffusion trainer with a checked task result
dailyInsight.insight: Unsloth merged a shared fine-tuning interface for seven text-diffusion model families. It reuses familiar data handling while preserving model-specific learning recipes.
dailyInsight.mechanism: DiffusionTrainer delegates the training objective to a family profile. The Gemma profile supplies its corrupted canvas through decoder_input_ids and selects the last contiguous supervised response span; the shared input format does not make every family's supervision equivalent.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Researchers can assemble experiments with less separate integration work, while checking that the intended answer actually reaches the learning objective. Existing diffusion fine-tuning routes predate this change.

actions.label: Check release inclusion and the supervised target before comparing models
actions.instruction: When a released package contains the October 10 trainer, pin the package, model and dataset. Inspect which response tokens each profile supervises, then run a small disposable held-out task comparison against the unmodified model. Record memory and training cost as well as answer quality.
actions.effort: One bounded experiment after package inclusion is established

receipts.title: Shared diffusion trainer and model-family recipes
receipts.supports: Merged shared data machinery, distinct learning objectives and canvas integration.

receipts.title: Gemma objective defines the supervised span and canvas input
receipts.supports: Last contiguous supervised span, decoder_input_ids and distinct encoder/canvas learning terms.

confidence.basis: Inspected source, historical loader, user report, notebook correction and tests; independent challenge verified the historical and release boundary.

dailyInsight.limitation: We did not train models or run the suite. Python package inclusion is unverified, and the inspected Desktop beta predates the merge. Upstream's one-seed Sudoku experiment cannot establish general quality or isolate a single correction.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A pinned containing release that fails to preserve the intended training targets or reproduce the objective contract would weaken the practical integration finding. A changed Gemma span rule would revise the supervision caveat.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A released, reproducible setup with explicit supervised targets and a held-out task result, including memory and training cost.
